js: const MOS=['Januar','Februar','März','April','Mai','Juni','Juli','August','September','Oktober','November','Dezember'];const DWL=['Montag','Dienstag','Mittwoch','Donnerstag','Freitag','Samstag','Sonntag'];let notes=[];const now=new Date();const pad=n=>n<10?'0'+n:''+n;const fmt=(y,m,d)=>y+'-'+pad(m+1)+'-'+pad(d);const cid=s=>'c'+s.split('-').join('');const human=s=>{const p=s.split('-');return p[2]+'.'+p[1]+'.'+p[0]};const wd=s=>{const p=s.split('-');return (new Date(+p[0],+p[1]-1,+p[2]).getDay()+6)%7};const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"');if(state.y==null){state.y=now.getFullYear();state.m=now.getMonth();state.sel=fmt(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),now.getDate());}if(state.draft==null)state.draft='';function load(){ui.db.select('notes',{},r=>{if(r.ok)notes=r.rows;drawCal();drawNotes();});}function hasN(s){return notes.some(n=>n.date===s);}function drawCal(){ui.text('mtitle',MOS[state.m]+' '+state.y);const off=(new Date(state.y,state.m,1).getDay()+6)%7;const dim=new Date(state.y,state.m+1,0).getDate();const cells=[];for(let i=0;i');for(let d=1;d<=dim;d++){const s=fmt(state.y,state.m,d);cells.push(''+d+(hasN(s)?'●':'')+'');}while(cells.length%7)cells.push('');let h='';for(let i=0;i';h+=cells[i];if(i%7===6)h+='';}ui.html('cal',h);for(let d=1;d<=dim;d++){const s=fmt(state.y,state.m,d);ui.attr(cid(s),'aria-pressed',s===state.sel?'true':'false');ui.on(cid(s),'click',()=>pick(s));}}function markSel(){const dim=new Date(state.y,state.m+1,0).getDate();for(let d=1;d<=dim;d++){const s=fmt(state.y,state.m,d);ui.attr(cid(s),'aria-pressed',s===state.sel?'true':'false');}}function pick(s){state.sel=s;ui.persist();markSel();drawNotes();}function drawNotes(){ui.text('seltitle',DWL[wd(state.sel)]+', '+human(state.sel));const list=notes.filter(n=>n.date===state.sel);ui.text('ncount',list.length===1?'1 Notiz':list.length+' Notizen');if(!list.length){ui.html('notes','');ui.text('emptymsg','Noch keine Notiz an diesem Tag.');return;}ui.text('emptymsg','');let h='';for(const n of list)h+=''+esc(n.text)+'×';ui.html('notes',h);for(const n of list)ui.on('x'+n.id,'click',()=>ui.db.delete('notes',n.id,()=>load()));}ui.on('prev','click',()=>{state.m--;if(state.m<0){state.m=11;state.y--;}ui.persist();drawCal();});ui.on('next','click',()=>{state.m++;if(state.m>11){state.m=0;state.y++;}ui.persist();drawCal();});ui.on('today','click',()=>{state.y=now.getFullYear();state.m=now.getMonth();state.sel=fmt(state.y,state.m,now.getDate());ui.persist();drawCal();drawNotes();});ui.on('ntext','input',e=>{state.draft=e.value;ui.persist();});ui.on('add','click',()=>{const v=(state.draft||'').trim();if(!v)return;ui.db.insert('notes',{date:state.sel,text:v},r=>{if(r.ok){state.draft='';ui.value('ntext','');ui.persist();load();}});});ui.value('ntext',state.draft||'');ui.db.create('notes',['date','text'],()=>load());
